sources.title: Digital Twins in Agriculture: Orchestration and Applications
sources.venue: Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry
sources.mechanism: Agricultural digital-twin orchestration connects heterogeneous data, models, and lifecycle processes.
sources.agroqFeature: Controlled soil–plant–microbe evidence graph and digital-twin translation registry.
sources.reproductionTarget: Map a deterministic synthetic plot, treatment, microbial observation, and plant-response trace.
sources.limitations: A review does not validate an AgroQ biological twin or causal plant–microbe prediction.
sources.requiredClassicalBaseline: Rule-based evidence graph with manually verified observations.
sources.hardwareFieldRestrictions: Synthetic records only; no live sensor or field actuation.

sources.title: Enhancing soil science research with multi-agent artificial intelligence systems
sources.mechanism: Multi-agent AI is proposed for hypothesis generation, experiment planning, and analysis in soil science.
sources.agroqFeature: Human-supervised research-agent evaluation and immutable review history.
sources.reproductionTarget: Evaluate one bounded synthetic soil-research task against a single-agent and rule-based baseline.
sources.limitations: The article does not establish autonomous scientific reliability or permission to act in the field.
sources.requiredClassicalBaseline: Rule-based workflow and conventional supervised model.
sources.hardwareFieldRestrictions: No autonomous experiment execution or equipment control.

sources.title: FAIR digital twins for biodiversity: enabling data, model, and workflow integration
sources.mechanism: FAIR-oriented integration connects data, models, provenance, and reproducible workflows.
sources.agroqFeature: FAIR evidence package, data dictionary, provenance, versions, checksums, and citation manifest.
sources.reproductionTarget: Export a deterministic synthetic digital-acre package with machine-readable provenance.
sources.limitations: FAIR packaging improves reuse and traceability but does not establish scientific validity.
sources.requiredClassicalBaseline: Versioned CSV/JSON export with documented schema and SHA-256 manifest.

sources.title: Explainable AI-driven interpretation of environmental drivers of tomato fruit expansion in smart greenhouses using IoT sensing
sources.mechanism: Random-forest modeling with SHAP and partial-dependence explanations over greenhouse sensing variables.
sources.agroqFeature: Frozen-model evaluation, feature contributions, uncertainty, model cards, and human decisions.
sources.reproductionTarget: Use a deterministic synthetic dataset to compare an interpretable linear baseline and a tree model.
sources.limitations: Published greenhouse results do not transfer automatically to AgroQ crops, sites, or synthetic data.
sources.requiredClassicalBaseline: Interpretable linear or rule-based baseline under the same split and seed.
sources.hardwareFieldRestrictions: No live IoT sensing or field recommendation.

sources.title: An agricultural digital twin for mandarins demonstrates the potential for individualized agriculture
sources.mechanism: Regional, inter-orchard, and intra-orchard data integration with statistical and machine-learning analysis.
sources.agroqFeature: Evidence-traceable plot and zone digital-twin workspace.
sources.limitations: A mandarin research system does not validate AgroQ for other crops or real-time operation.
sources.hardwareFieldRestrictions: Synthetic demonstration; field mode remains locked.

sources.title: Placement and drone flight path mapping of agricultural soil sensors using machine learning
sources.mechanism: Sequential gap reduction for sensor placement and genetic-algorithm planning of simulated multi-agent flight paths.
sources.agroqFeature: Synthetic sensor placement, soil sampling, adjacency, inspection, and UAV-route research benchmark.
sources.reproductionTarget: Compare deterministic greedy placement and routing with an optional registered QUBO under matched budgets.
sources.limitations: Route simulation does not authorize or demonstrate drone operation, safety, or regulatory compliance.
sources.requiredClassicalBaseline: Greedy placement and deterministic shortest-route heuristic.
sources.hardwareFieldRestrictions: No sensors, UAVs, drones, or physical installation.
